# Anna Pogrebniak

> Fractional growth marketer for B2B SaaS, based in Helsinki, Finland. 11 years of experience, 19 brands worked with, 2.5M EUR in ad spend managed. Builds the marketing engine, runs the ads, sets up the ops. Founder of The Awesome Marketers, Finland's largest English-speaking marketing community.

Anna works with European B2B SaaS companies as a fractional (part-time, senior) marketer, typically as the first or only marketing hire. First marketing hire for 3 brands. Ad budgets managed range from 3k to 50k EUR per month.

## Services
- Fractional growth marketing: full-stack marketing lead, strategy and execution in one person. Growth strategy, demand gen, HubSpot and ops setup, content and SEO, LinkedIn thought leadership.
- Fractional performance marketing: paid ads strategy, execution, and optimisation on LinkedIn, Google, and Meta. Multi-market funnels, retargeting and ABM, reporting and iteration.
- Fractional GTM: outbound prospecting engine. ICP targeting, cold email and LinkedIn sequences, multi-channel automation, CRM and calendar setup, landing pages.

## Selected results
- 250k EUR yearly ad budget managed at 4.7:1 LTV:CAC across five European markets for an enterprise sales-led tool.
- 50% of a 1M EUR open pipeline brand-influenced as a solo marketer, via paid LinkedIn and thought leadership content.
- 200 leads at 20 EUR CPL on a 4k EUR one-month budget for a new product launch; 5% lead-to-meeting blended, 15% on LinkedIn.
- 150 ICP leads from one webinar on a 2.5k EUR ad and tool budget, for an enterprise sales tool with zero prior marketing.
- Cost per MQL cut by 40% in 3 months after taking over existing ads for a PLG brand.
- 15 ICP meetings booked from zero for a pre-PMF startup with no website and no marketing, on a 400 EUR/month tool budget.

## Brands worked with
Lumoa (feedback analytics, FI), Netigate (survey tech, SE), AddSearch (website search, FI), Hello Customer (AI VoC platform, BE), Trustmary (AI visibility tool, FI), QPR Software (business intelligence, FI), Tangently (AI fintech, FI), GetSharedContacts (Gmail widget, FR), and more across Europe.

## Skills
Marketing and growth strategy, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads, SEO and GEO, email nurture, marketing automation, HubSpot, marketing operations, ABM, lead scoring, content strategy, webinars, cold outreach, Claude and agentic AI.
